prerequisite.state: Applied to the index before this separate unstaged delta.

scope: Synthetic Linux Node/SQLite, authenticated API and encrypted recovery. HTTP-enabled regression uses loopback only. No browser, physical-device, real-provider, production, hosting-capacity or release acceptance claim.

runtimeSource.captureScope: Baseline captured after the new test cases and before runtime repair. Candidate captured after the focused and affected regression, before documentation packaging. No runtime/test file changed between candidate repair, verification and capture.

defects.finding: Request creation/update and deletion can report success with invalid or backward timestamps. Public reads or encrypted recovery may then fail.
defects.repair: Validate and capture one operation timestamp before writes, and reject any change before the affected request updated time.

defects.finding: Request and restriction fan-out can increment a safe terminal revision into an unsafe integer. Suppression/safety calls previously reported success and later reads failed.
defects.repair: Preflight all affected request metadata and revisions inside the transaction before ledger, row or audit writes.

defects.finding: Archive validation accepted request timestamps outside the JavaScript Date range or in reversed chronology, then published an unreadable restored database.
defects.repair: Validate request creation/update range and chronology and suppression timestamp range before publishing a restored database.

compatibility.allowedMutationClock: At or after every affected request updated_at. Equal timestamps remain valid.
compatibility.liveRevisionAdvance: Only from positive safe versions below Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1. The resulting live version may equal Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1.
compatibility.existingTerminalRevision: Positive safe request versions through Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER remain readable and recoverable. New live increments from terminal revisions fail 409 version_exhausted before writes.
compatibility.wholeRequestDeletion: Version Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1 may be removed with a safe Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER deletion receipt. Conversation deletion preserves a live record and follows the live increment bound.
compatibility.exactRetries: Existing create and deletion results return before mutation guards. Already-recorded restrictions with no remaining affected writes also succeed without mutating state.
compatibility.invalidArchives: Invalid request or suppression chronology/range fails invalid_database before restore publication. Source and temporary restore state remain unchanged or cleaned.
compatibility.excludedPaths: Profile revisions, session last_seen clocks and panel mutations are separately owned milestones.
